examples.text_en: A good porter can be a great help to us.
examples.text_zh: 一位好的搬运工能给我们帮大忙。

examples.text_en: She keeps her best work in a large portfolio.
examples.text_zh: 她把自己最好的作品放在一个大型公文夹里。

examples.text_en: The portfolio held all the money for the family.
examples.text_zh: 这份资产组合里装着全家的钱。

examples.text_en: The portraitist made the whole family look good.
examples.text_zh: 这位肖像画家把全家人都画得很好看。

examples.text_en: A portraitist can be found in the old city.
examples.text_zh: 在这座老城里能找到一位肖像画家。

examples.text_en: Her portraiture was full of care and hard work.
examples.text_zh: 她的肖像画充满心血和辛勤。

examples.text_en: They read about portraiture in a book about old art.
examples.text_zh: 他们在一本关于古代艺术的书里读到肖像画法。

examples.text_en: The film will portray the life of a poor family.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影将描绘一个贫困家庭的生活。

examples.text_en: She can portray a strong woman in a hard time.
examples.text_zh: 她能刻画困难时期一位坚强的女性。

examples.text_en: His portrayal of the old king was very strong.
examples.text_zh: 他对老国王的刻画非常有力。

examples.text_en: The book gives a clear portrayal of the whole event.
examples.text_zh: 这本书清楚地描绘了整个事件。

examples.text_en: He is a poseur who wants to look like a king.
examples.text_zh: 他是个装模作样的人，总想显得像个国王。

examples.text_en: The poseur talked a lot but did very little.
examples.text_zh: 这个装腔作势的人说得多做得少。

examples.text_en: They posit that the plan will work in time.
examples.text_zh: 他们假设这个计划最终会奏效。

examples.text_en: We can posit a world with no war at all.
examples.text_zh: 我们可以假设一个完全没有战争的世界。

examples.text_en: She was positively sure about the whole thing.
examples.text_zh: 她对整件事十分确信。

examples.text_en: His answer was positively full of force.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答明确而有力。

examples.text_en: Her positiveness gave the whole team more hope.
examples.text_zh: 她的自信给整支队伍带来了更多希望。

examples.text_en: There was positiveness in his voice that morning.
examples.text_zh: 那天早上他的声音里透着自信。

examples.text_en: The posse will go out to find the bad man.
examples.text_zh: 这支地方武装队会出发去寻找那个坏人。

examples.text_en: A posse was formed to keep the town safe.
examples.text_zh: 为了保卫小镇的安全，一支队伍被组织起来。

examples.text_en: The postage for this book was quite low.
examples.text_zh: 这本书的邮资相当低。

examples.text_en: They pay postage when they send a card.
examples.text_zh: 他们寄卡片时要付邮资。

examples.text_en: The postal service in this town is very good.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇的邮政服务非常好。

examples.text_en: He works for the postal group in our city.
examples.text_zh: 他在我们城市的邮政部门工作。

examples.text_en: She put the card in the old postbox outside.
examples.text_zh: 她把卡片投进外面的旧邮筒里。

examples.text_en: The postbox was full of things that morning.
examples.text_zh: 那天早上邮筒里装满了东西。

examples.text_en: Please put your postcode on the top of the page.
examples.text_zh: 请在页面顶部写上你的邮政编码。

examples.text_en: The postcode helps the group find the house.
examples.text_zh: 邮政编码能帮工作人员找到这所房子。

examples.text_en: He would postdate the card by a few days.
examples.text_zh: 他会把这张卡片的日期往后填几天。

examples.text_en: Please do not postdate the report for any reason.
examples.text_zh: 请无论如何都不要把报告的日期填后。

examples.text_en: The posterior part of the building was quite old.
examples.text_zh: 这座建筑的后半部分相当古老。

examples.text_en: He felt a pain in the posterior part of his body.
examples.text_zh: 他感到身体后面一处疼痛。
